entry_state: A report edition and a reconstructed history answer different questions. Apple's reported asset balances reject one payment-equals-additions history but do not identify its replacement. Conditional offsets must preserve detailed rows, taxes and notes; equal liabilities can still imply different settlement timing and cash categories. The lease/tax schedule has begun, with a filename aside queued for editorial repair.
exit_state: Lease tax and Apple's tax disclosures separate expense, balances, restricted funds and settlement. The Northstar forecast retains one shared unknown across statements. Awards and capitalisation need their own measurement facts. Subsequent returns reconcile debit-positive journals, while impairment reversals retain an unresolved case when every eligible allocation weight is zero.
findings: The lease company schedule balances both years and retains gross DTA/DTL plus delayed current-tax settlement; RR-002 remains queued.

Apple tax residuals U4901 and V-1080 are diagnostic differences, not identified journals. The Ireland dollar settlement residual excludes zero under the stated rounding model, while the euro residual does not.
An uncertain-tax balance range does not create a payment probability law. One shared floating fraction drives the Northstar statements.
The returns entries use an explicitly debit-positive convention and sum to zero. Impairment headroom is a cap, not an evidenced allocation weight. No new confirmed defect.
